headline: Konyaspor favourites despite one goal in five
summary: Konyaspor are 16th of 18 with 5 points and host Gençlerbirliği, the team one place above them — a direct chance to climb. The problem sits at the sharp end: 1 goal in their last five league games, and just 0.25 expected goals in the 1-0 defeat at Amed last weekend. The visitors have their own trouble, with their last two away games ending 0-4 and 0-5. Even so, the market keeps Konyaspor favourites at 51.2%, the handicap makes them half a goal better, and over 2.5 goals is a 46.8% chance. Ajansspor reports a FIFA transfer ban at the club.
read: Konyaspor are home favourites at 51.2% against a Gençlerbirliği side with no win in five and 14 goals conceded in that run — but the home team have scored just once in five games themselves, so the market sees a tight, low-scoring match with under 2.5 goals favoured at 53.2%. The week's off-field story is a reported FIFA transfer ban on Konyaspor, which does not affect the team selection.

facts.fact: Konyaspor are priced 51.2% to win at home, more than twice Gençlerbirliği's 22.0%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the home side favourites, but only narrowly — this is not a one-sided match-up.

facts.fact: The fair handicap line sits at -0.56 to Konyaspor, with the main line at -0.5.
Konyaspor have scored one goal in their last five league matches.
facts.meaning: The home side's problem is at the sharp end: they are not creating or finishing enough to make home advantage count comfortably.

facts.fact: Gençlerbirliği's last five league games read LDLLL — 3 scored, 14 conceded.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive on the worst run of the two, conceding almost three goals a game.

facts.fact: Konyaspor lost 1-0 at Amed last weekend having created just 0.25 xG.
facts.meaning: The drought is not bad luck — the home side generated almost no chances at all in their last game.

facts.fact: Konyaspor are 16th of 18 with 5 points from 8 games.
facts.meaning: A home game against the team one place above them is a direct chance to climb out of the bottom group.

facts.fact: Under 2.5 goals is the favoured side of the total at 53.2%.
facts.meaning: The market leans towards a tight, low-scoring game rather than an open one.

facts.fact: FIFA has imposed a transfer ban on Konyaspor, according to Ajansspor.

sources.fact: Konyaspor trained under head coach İlhan Palut ahead of the Gençlerbirliği match, with the goalkeepers working separately from the rest of the squad.
Ajansspor reports that FIFA has imposed a transfer ban on Konyaspor, closing the club's transfer window.
Konyaspor lost 1-0 away at Amedspor in week 8 of the Süper Lig.
Ajansspor reports that Konyaspor have not made the start to the season they wanted.
Konyaspor were referred to the PFDK (disciplinary board) along with Amedspor after their week 8 league match.
Some Konyaspor fans have reacted against the free-ticket scheme launched for the Gençlerbirliği and Galatasaray matches.
Gençlerbirliği began preparations for the Konyaspor trip under coach Bernd Storck, with Cheikh Niasse training with the team while some other players worked individually.
Hakimiyet reports that three Gençlerbirliği players did not take part in training, while Cheikh Niasse trained with the squad.
